purpose: Increase qualified organic discovery, repeat exploration, deep-link sharing and useful downstream planning intent from the production-reconciled 751-place ERN catalog.

workstreams.action: Notify IndexNow after successful production deploys using only the recently updated crawlable destination feed plus core discovery URLs. Keep Google on sitemap/Search Console; do not treat submission as guaranteed indexing.
workstreams.successSignal: Faster Bing/participating-engine discovery of genuinely updated ERN destination pages.

workstreams.action: Maintain the 751-place production-reconciled discovery universe with crawlable destination pages, aliases, geography, source type, currentness, related ERN places and useful planning context. Improve depth and freshness before adding count.
workstreams.successSignal: More non-owner organic/AI landings that continue into additional ERN places.

workstreams.action: Publish substantial crawlable country hubs only where ERN has at least six current or schedule-verified destinations. Link destination pages back to the country hub and keep payment irrelevant to inclusion.
workstreams.successSignal: More qualified country-level search/social landings that continue into multiple ERN destination pages.

workstreams.action: Publish a bounded Atom feed of recently updated crawlable destination pages and advertise it from robots.txt and the homepage. Keep source-derived last-modified dates authoritative.
workstreams.successSignal: Search/feed crawlers can discover meaningful recent destination changes without repeated full-site rediscovery.

workstreams.action: Use the 751-place catalog to deepen long-tail search and AI discovery across countries, islands, cities, mountains, parks, wildlife and current-condition queries. Add new places only for demonstrated geographic/provider/visitor utility gaps.
workstreams.successSignal: Broader search-query coverage across place names, islands, mountains, parks and current-condition searches.

workstreams.action: Make each crawlable destination page directly shareable with canonical destination-specific URLs, clear current-source status and useful related/country routes.
workstreams.successSignal: More referral landings on destination pages and more multi-place exploration after a shared entry.

workstreams.action: Keep travel options downstream from a viewed/searched place and measure aggregate travel_option_opened by destination/intent.
workstreams.successSignal: Sustained qualified outbound planning clicks across multiple destinations.

workstreams.action: Use related destinations, Browse All, geography/category discovery and Wander to move visitors beyond the landing page.
workstreams.successSignal: More place opens per visitor and lower single-page abandonment.

workstreams.action: Use currently link-generation-capable utilities such as Airalo, Go City, Kiwitaxi, Radical Storage, Aviasales and KKday only where they solve a clear visitor need.
workstreams.successSignal: First genuine non-owner utility clicks/conversions without cluttering ERN.

workstreams.action: Recheck traffic-gated Travelpayouts programs only after a platform status change, first affiliate conversion, sustained qualified outbound activity, or material organic traffic growth.
workstreams.successSignal: A previously locked program exposes usable/approved link-generation controls.

workstreams.action: Favor destination and country deep links in manual organic sharing rather than repeatedly sharing only the homepage, so social visitors land on a specific useful Earth view and can continue through related places.
workstreams.successSignal: Referral traffic spreads across destination pages and generates more multi-place exploration.

workstreams.action: Count only successful native-share or copy-link actions from both crawlable destination pages and the main ERN viewer. Use aggregate destination/share data to learn which Earth views visitors naturally pass along; never infer private social reach.
workstreams.successSignal: Reliable aggregate share/copy counts across destination-page and in-app viewing surfaces.

workstreams.action: Use privacy-safe aggregate zero-result triage to research real visitor demand. A query such as Chiang Mai may open a source-research lane, but no destination becomes public until source truth, currentness, rights and target identity independently pass ERN gates.
workstreams.successSignal: Repeated genuine visitor search gaps shrink through truthful source resolution rather than aliases or fabricated coverage.

workstreams.action: Treat Home + Watch Earth opening quality as traffic retention infrastructure: prioritize truthful source-backed imagery, provider/geographic variety and fast continuation into another place.
workstreams.successSignal: Referral and search visitors open more than one place and fewer first impressions depend on illustrative fallback.

workstreams.action: Promote sharing of destination-specific URLs from the viewer and crawlable destination pages, then use aggregate successful share/copy events only as a directional signal. Never infer private social reach.
workstreams.successSignal: Clean v2 destination share/copy events become non-zero and referral landings distribute across place pages instead of only the homepage.

workstreams.action: Use Taitung Jinzun as the quality benchmark: a strong truthful Earth source, clear source status, useful related-place continuation and optional downstream planning only while playback/currentness gates are satisfied.
workstreams.successSignal: More high-value destinations reach the same source-truth + continuation + planning quality without commercial influence on ranking.

note: Catalog scale is no longer the bottleneck. The traffic strategy now starts from 751 healthy searchable places and prioritizes first-impression quality, deep destination entry, repeat exploration, shareable place URLs, genuine repeated search gaps and useful downstream planning. Traffic never overrides source truth/currentness.

latestObservedTraffic.interpretationBoundary: Aggregate privacy-preserving evidence only. Traffic metric semantics v2 is active. Rolling totals still contain historical window activity, while destination ranking now uses clean v2 place-open attribution. No counts identify individual visitors or prove channel causation, bookings, conversions or revenue.
latestObservedTraffic.topPlacesInterpretation: Clean v2 destination-open attribution is now non-empty. Current ranking begins after the 2026-10-07T14:55:03Z attribution boundary and should remain separate from older legacy place counters.
